The FTC's Credit Karma enforcement example shows manipulative 'dark pattern' design (an A/B-tested false 'pre-approved' claim chosen because it drove more clicks) deployed in a financial-product context, and the report documents dark patterns used across many digital industries specifically to increase consumer engagement.
